# hacienda - FFI (C/C++) Bindings

Bindings for hacienda

## Installation

Link against `libhacienda_ffi` and include `hacienda.h`.

See the build instructions in the main repository.

## Quick Start

```c
#include "hacienda.h"

int main(void) {
    // See https://github.com/jamon8888/hacienda-engine for usage examples.
    return 0;
}
```
